Blind design critic for piece=home-first-viewport round=r2.

Inspect:
- Ours: gauntlet/pieces/home-first-viewport/r2/ (first-viewport-desktop.png, first-viewport-mobile.png, NOTES.md)
- Bar first viewports; home-first-viewport-r1.md
Criteria: brand name hero, one composition, no cards in hero, brand test without nav.

Blind A/B. Write gauntlet/critics/home-first-viewport-r2.md with winner us|bar|tie, biggest_gap, next_build_instruction, evidence_paths, blind_ab_note.
Harsh.
I’m using the caveman skill in ultra mode for the blind visual audit, then I’ll compare both first viewports and write the critic file with a decisive verdict.

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"sed -n '1,240p' /Users/dhruv2mars/.agents/skills/caveman/SKILL.md && printf '\\n---MEMORY---\\n' && rg -n -i \"gauntlet|home-first-viewport|blind|critic\" /Users/dhruv2mars/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md | head -40","workdir":"/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":12000});
text(r.output);

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"printf '%s\\n' '---FILES---'; rg --files gauntlet/pieces/home-first-viewport/r2 gauntlet | sort; printf '%s\\n' '---R1---'; sed -n '1,240p' gauntlet/critics/home-first-viewport-r1.md 2>/dev/null || true; printf '%s\\n' '---NOTES---'; sed -n '1,240p' gauntlet/pieces/home-first-viewport/r2/NOTES.md 2>/dev/null || true","workdir":"/Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio","yield_time_ms":10000,"max_output_tokens":12000});
